items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I remember telling him, when he came to Sissle's orchestra... Tommy Ladnier was not with the orchestra yet.

ctx.x: And he made a top D, 'cause he always told me, Tommy, he said to me, things like that I understand, he said, "When I was with Fletcher (He) Anderson's orchestra, one of the arrangements I had to open, and hitting a top D."
He said, "I opened the number with a top D." So, I said to him, "What have you been doing since?" (Laughter).
